name: dev.flypod/flypod
title: flypod
description: Deploy a folder of static files or Markdown to a live public URL. No account needed.

tools.name: deploy_site
tools.description: Publishes files as a new public website and returns its URL. Each call creates a separate site at a new URL; update_site changes an existing one. Limits: 200 files and 4 MB in total. The result includes a site_id and a manage_token that the other site tools require. The site is public to anyone with the URL and, without an account, is removed after 14 days; the result's keep_url is a page where the person can sign in and keep it permanently.

files.description: Text files to publish, as a map from path to file content, e.g. {"index.html": "<!doctype html>…", "css/site.css": "…"}. Paths are relative, use forward slashes, and must not start with a slash. The site needs an index.html at its root (a single .html file is served as the home page; a set of .md files with no index.html is rendered as a site). A single self-contained HTML file with inline CSS and JavaScript is the most reliable thing to publish.

binary_files.description: Optional non-text files (images, fonts) as a map from path to base64-encoded bytes. Intended for a few small assets; text belongs in `files`.

tools.name: update_site
tools.description: Replaces the content of an existing site with the given files, at the same URL. The files are the complete new version, not a patch: anything left out is no longer served. The previous version is kept and rollback_site restores it.

site_id.description: The site_id returned by deploy_site, or listed by list_sites.

manage_token.description: The manage_token returned by deploy_site for this site. Needed while the site is temporary; not needed for a site that belongs to the signed-in account.

files.description: Text files to publish, as a map from path to file content, e.g. {"index.html": "<!doctype html>…", "css/site.css": "…"}. Paths are relative, use forward slashes, and must not start with a slash. The site needs an index.html at its root (a single .html file is served as the home page; a set of .md files with no index.html is rendered as a site). A single self-contained HTML file with inline CSS and JavaScript is the most reliable thing to publish.

binary_files.description: Optional non-text files (images, fonts) as a map from path to base64-encoded bytes. Intended for a few small assets; text belongs in `files`.

tools.name: rollback_site
tools.description: Makes an earlier version of a site live again at the same URL. With no version_id it restores the version before the current one. get_site lists the versions available.

site_id.description: The site_id returned by deploy_site, or listed by list_sites.

manage_token.description: The manage_token returned by deploy_site for this site. Needed while the site is temporary; not needed for a site that belongs to the signed-in account.

version_id.description: The version to make live. Omit for the previous version.

tools.name: get_site
tools.description: Returns a site's URL, name, when it expires, which version is live, and its version history.

site_id.description: The site_id returned by deploy_site, or listed by list_sites.

manage_token.description: The manage_token returned by deploy_site for this site. Needed while the site is temporary; not needed for a site that belongs to the signed-in account.

tools.name: compare_versions
tools.description: Lists the files added, removed and modified between two versions of a site. With no arguments beyond the site it compares the live version with the one before it.

site_id.description: The site_id returned by deploy_site, or listed by list_sites.

manage_token.description: The manage_token returned by deploy_site for this site. Needed while the site is temporary; not needed for a site that belongs to the signed-in account.

from.description: The older version_id. Defaults to the version before `to`.

to.description: The newer version_id. Defaults to the live version.

tools.name: duplicate_site
tools.description: Copies a temporary site's live content to a new site at a new URL, leaving the original untouched. The copy is temporary and comes with its own site_id and manage_token. A site that belongs to an account cannot be duplicated this way.

site_id.description: The site_id returned by deploy_site, or listed by list_sites.

tools.name: configure_timeline
tools.description: Shows or hides a History chip on the site's pages that lets any visitor open its earlier versions and compare two of them, which is useful while a site is being reviewed. Off by default. When it is on, the result includes a history_url that shows two versions side by side, and get_site lists a url for each version. While it is on, versions that were replaced remain publicly viewable.

site_id.description: The site_id returned by deploy_site, or listed by list_sites.

manage_token.description: The manage_token returned by deploy_site for this site. Needed while the site is temporary; not needed for a site that belongs to the signed-in account.

enabled.description: True to show the timeline, false to hide it.

tools.name: protect_site
tools.description: Makes a site private behind a password (flypod Pro), or shows its password again. With enabled true and no password, flypod makes a strong one (four words and a number) if the site has none, and otherwise keeps it. The result has the password, a share_url that opens the site without typing, and a curl line for scripts. The share_url (or the password) is what the person shares. rotate makes a new password, which signs every device and link out. enabled false makes the site public again. Without Pro it fails with an upgrade link.

site_id.description: The site_id returned by deploy_site, or listed by list_sites.

manage_token.description: The manage_token returned by deploy_site for this site. Needed while the site is temporary; not needed for a site that belongs to the signed-in account.

enabled.description: True (default) to protect the site or show its password; false to make it public.

password.description: A password of the person's own choosing, 8 characters or more. Omit to have flypod make one.

rotate.description: True for a new generated password.

tools.name: configure_domain
tools.description: Connects a custom domain such as www.example.com to a site (flypod Pro). The result names the person's DNS provider, the one record to add in that provider's own field names, a link to the page where it is added, and `say`: the same steps in one plain sentence for the person. With no domain it reports the status, which goes pending_dns, then pending_certificate, then active (usually minutes after the record is added). If `problem` is set, its fix says exactly what to change. remove true disconnects the domain. A www. subdomain works with every DNS provider.

site_id.description: The site_id returned by deploy_site, or listed by list_sites.

manage_token.description: The manage_token returned by deploy_site for this site. Needed while the site is temporary; not needed for a site that belongs to the signed-in account.

domain.description: The domain to connect, e.g. www.example.com. Omit to get the status of the site's domains.

remove.description: True to disconnect `domain` from the site.

tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: Lists the sites that belong to the flypod account this connector is signed in to, with each site's URL and name.

tools.name: keep_site
tools.description: Attaches a temporary site to the signed-in flypod account so it no longer expires. The URL does not change. Requires the connector to be signed in; otherwise the person can use the keep_url from deploy_site.

site_id.description: The site_id returned by deploy_site, or listed by list_sites.

manage_token.description: The manage_token returned by deploy_site for this site.

tools.name: rename_site
tools.description: Sets the display name of a site on the account page. The URL does not change. An empty name clears it.

site_id.description: The site_id returned by deploy_site, or listed by list_sites.

name.description: The new display name, up to 80 characters.

tools.name: delete_site
tools.description: Permanently deletes a site that belongs to the signed-in account: its URL stops working and every version is removed. This cannot be undone.

site_id.description: The site_id returned by deploy_site, or listed by list_sites.

tools.name: upgrade_plan
tools.description: Returns a payment link for flypod Pro: custom domains, password-protected sites, and higher limits on deploys, storage and updates per hour. The person pays on that page themselves (card, Apple Pay or Google Pay; about 30 seconds); calling this tool charges nothing. Once they have paid, the account has Pro's features and limits. Signed in, the link is for this connector's account; otherwise it asks the person to sign in first.

tools.name: configure_comments
tools.description: Enables or disables visitor comments on a site and sets who may comment: `anonymous` (anyone), `passcode` (anyone with the shared passcode), or `approved` (comments appear after the owner approves them). Disabling keeps existing comments. Only the site's owner can change this.

site_id.description: The site_id returned by deploy_site, or listed by list_sites.

enabled.description: True to turn comments on, false to turn them off.

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: Lists the comment threads on a site, each with the text it is attached to, its status and its first comment. Also reports whether comments are enabled and in which mode.

site_id.description: The site_id returned by deploy_site, or listed by list_sites.

status.description: Which threads to list. Defaults to open. `pending` is the moderation queue.

page.description: Only threads on this page path, e.g. `/` or `/pricing.html`.

tools.name: get_comment_thread
tools.description: Returns one comment thread with every reply.

site_id.description: The site_id returned by deploy_site, or listed by list_sites.

thread_id.description: The thread_id of a comment thread, as returned by list_comments.

tools.name: post_comment
tools.description: Starts a comment thread on a page of a site, attached to a passage of its text. `quote` has to be text that appears on the page exactly as written there.

site_id.description: The site_id returned by deploy_site, or listed by list_sites.

quote.description: The exact text on the page the comment is about.

tools.name: reply_to_comment
tools.description: Adds a reply to an existing comment thread.

site_id.description: The site_id returned by deploy_site, or listed by list_sites.

thread_id.description: The thread_id of a comment thread, as returned by list_comments.

tools.name: update_comment_thread
tools.description: Changes the state of a comment thread: `resolve` marks it done, `reopen` undoes that, and `approve` or `reject` decide a thread waiting in the moderation queue (owner only).

site_id.description: The site_id returned by deploy_site, or listed by list_sites.

thread_id.description: The thread_id of a comment thread, as returned by list_comments.

tools.name: delete_comment_thread
tools.description: Deletes a comment thread. Allowed for the thread's author and for the site's owner.

site_id.description: The site_id returned by deploy_site, or listed by list_sites.

thread_id.description: The thread_id of a comment thread, as returned by list_comments.
